description: This file defines a wizard for creating delivery orders in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form layout, default values, and actions for setting up delivery lines based on selected carriers.

classes.name: make_delivery
classes.description: Wizard interface class for creating delivery orders with defined states and actions.

methods.name: _delivery_default
methods.description: Sets default delivery form data based on the sale order in draft state.

methods.name: _delivery_set
methods.description: Creates delivery lines for sale orders based on selected carrier and grid.
